title: A single hold (Iron Downs/Cinderhall) with all its side content consumed ~85 turns; three holds plus companion recruitment plus Act I consumed the full 480-turn allowance before Act III's Hollow Throne could be resolved, despite pursuing the game's own recommended 'three hollows' minimum path efficiently and skipping most of the 15 available holds entirely.
